## Scaling of tick data and its CrI width
```{r}

## Scaling

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Read tick data
file_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Tick Data/predicted_tick.csv"
ticks <- read_csv(file_path)

# fucntion scale 0–1
scale_01 <- function(x) {
  q_low  <- quantile(x, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  x <- pmin(pmax(x, q_low), q_high)

  scaled <- (x - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)

  # shift range to 0.01–0.99
  scaled <- scaled * 0.98 + 0.01
  
  return(scaled)
}

# Step 1: compute scaled hazard + certainty
ticks_scaled <- ticks %>%
  mutate(
    # Amblyomma americanum (aa)
    PM_aa_scaled  = scale_01(PM_aa),
    CIw_aa_scaled = scale_01(CIw_aa),
    Cert_aa       = 1 - CIw_aa_scaled,

    # Dermacentor variabilis (dv)
    PM_dv_scaled  = scale_01(PM_dv),
    CIw_dv_scaled = scale_01(CIw_dv),
    Cert_dv       = 1 - CIw_dv_scaled,

    # Ixodes scapularis (is)
    PM_is_scaled  = scale_01(PM_is),
    CIw_is_scaled = scale_01(CIw_is),
    Cert_is       = 1 - CIw_is_scaled
  )

# keep only scaled hazard + scaled certainty (rounded)
ticks_final <- ticks_scaled %>%
  dplyr::select(
    County,
    PM_aa_scaled, Cert_aa,
    PM_dv_scaled, Cert_dv,
    PM_is_scaled, Cert_is
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 5)))

print(ticks_final)

# save
write_csv(
  ticks_final,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Tick Data/predicted_tick_scaled.csv"
)


```


##Human TBD cases and Annual average Incidence and scaling
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Read original human case data
file_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_cases.csv"
human <- read_csv(file_path)

# Combine diseases by vector
TBD_cases_by_vector <- human %>%
  mutate(
    is_tbd_cases = Anaplasmosis + Babesiosis + Lyme,
    dv_tbd_cases = `Spotted Fever Rickettsioses`,
    aa_tbd_cases = Ehrlichiosis
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    County,
    is_tbd_cases,
    dv_tbd_cases,
    aa_tbd_cases,
    population
  )

print(TBD_cases_by_vector)

# Export new simplified file
write_csv(
  TBD_cases_by_vector,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_cases_by_vector.csv"
)


# Calculating Annual Average Incidence per 100,000 population
human_inc <- TBD_cases_by_vector %>%
  mutate(
    Inc_is_cases = (is_tbd_cases / (population * 4)) * 1e5,
    Inc_dv_cases = (dv_tbd_cases / (population * 4)) * 1e5,
    Inc_aa_cases = (aa_tbd_cases / (population * 4)) * 1e5
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Inc_"), ~ round(.x, 4)))

print(human_inc)

# Export
write_csv(
  human_inc,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_annual_average_incidence_vector.csv"
)


# Scaling of the incidence
scale_01 <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(0, length(x))          # start everything at 0
  nz  <- x > 0                      # index of non-zero values
  
  if (sum(nz) < 2) return(out)      # safety: if fewer than 2 non-zero, return all zeros
  
  vals   <- x[nz]
  q_low  <- quantile(vals, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(vals, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  vals   <- pmin(pmax(vals, q_low), q_high)
  scaled <- (vals - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)
  scaled <- scaled * 0.98 + 0.01    # shift non-zero to 0.01–0.99
  
  out[nz] <- scaled
  return(out)
}

# Apply scaling to EXISTING incidence (no recalculation)
human_scaled <- human_inc %>%
  mutate(
    Inc_scaled_is_cases = scale_01(Inc_is_cases),
    Inc_scaled_dv_cases = scale_01(Inc_dv_cases),
    Inc_scaled_aa_cases = scale_01(Inc_aa_cases)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 5))
  )

print(human_scaled)

# Export
write_csv(
  human_scaled,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_annual_average_incidence_scaled_vector.csv"
)
```


## Annual average Tick bite inciedecne and scaling
```{r}

# Annual average tick-bite incidence

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

#library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Read data
file_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Tick bite/tick_encounter.csv"
bite <- read_csv(file_path)

# Calculate average annual incidence per 100,000
bite_inc <- bite %>%
  mutate(
    Inc_aa_bite    = (aa_bite    / (Population * 4)) * 1e5,
    Inc_dv_bite    = (dv_bite    / (Population * 4)) * 1e5,
    Inc_is_bite    = (is_bite    / (Population * 4)) * 1e5,
    Inc_total_bite = (total_bite / (Population * 4)) * 1e5
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Inc_"), ~ round(.x, 4)))

print(bite_inc)

# Export ONLY incidence
write_csv(
  bite_inc,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Tick bite/tick_bite_annual_average_incidence.csv"
)

#scaling of tick bite incidence
# SAME scaling function as predicted tick
scale_01 <- function(x) {
  q_low  <- quantile(x, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

  x <- pmin(pmax(x, q_low), q_high)

  scaled <- (x - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)
  scaled <- scaled * 0.98 + 0.01   # range: 0.01–0.99

  return(scaled)
}

# Apply scaling ONLY to incidence columns
bite_scaled <- bite_inc %>%
  mutate(
    Inc_scaled_aa_bite    = scale_01(Inc_aa_bite),
    Inc_scaled_dv_bite    = scale_01(Inc_dv_bite),
    Inc_scaled_is_bite    = scale_01(Inc_is_bite),
    Inc_scaled_total_bite = scale_01(Inc_total_bite)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 5)))

print(bite_scaled)

# Export scaled file
write_csv(
  bite_scaled,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Tick bite/tick_bite_annual_average_incidence_scaled.csv"
)


```
